levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: All three combinations are essentially the same foods rearranged.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least two of three combinations use a meaningfully different food-group mix.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All three combinations are distinct and the learner explains the food-group reasoning for each.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Reflection names at least one non-taste factor, like how it made them feel.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Reflection compares taste and at least one other factor across specific combinations.

lookFors: Each combination names its food groups explicitly.
Reflection is specific to the learner's actual three combinations, not generic.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
